[WP] A man wanders out of the desert after a four year absence.

"Do you have a name?" The sergeant asked the dusty man sitting on the other side of his desk.

"Umm... Kyle" The man answered.

"Do you have a last name?"

"Er... Kyle Vasten"

"Alright Kyle Vasten, do you have anyone who can pick you up?" The sergeant said typing the name into the database search bar. "Or do you have accommodations?"

"No. No" Kyle said looking around the police station.

"Are you sure?" the sergeant looked up.

"I'm sure" he said glancing to his sides.

The sergeant furrowed his brow. When the man was found, he was found collapsed in the burning sun at the edge of the desert. This man foolishly wandered into the desert unprepared and had only managed to escape dying from the heat by a stroke of luck. If the locals had not found him in the sand dunes, he would have been left for the scavengers of the desert. The only items found on him were his ripped clothing and single stone held firmly in his hands. The stone in question was on the desk in front of him. It was smooth and had no markings aside from a small etching on one of its side. The sergeant sat back in his chair and waited for the database to return any search results. The man shifted in his seat and look towards the exit.

"Do you have somewhere to be?" the sergeant raised an eyebrow.

"I need to go" the man said, shifting more in his seat.

"Go where?"

"Back... back to the desert"

"To the desert?" the sergeant sat up in seat. "You almost died going in there. Do you have a death wish?"

"I need to go back. I'm not done." The man said, restless in his seat.

"Listen, sir, we can't let you do that." The sergeant said.

"No. I need to go. I have to go. I must!" The man twisted in his seat and spun his head towards the exit.

The sergeant quickly stood up from his desk and tried to restrain the frantic man. As he neared, the computer beeped and for a split second, his attention was drawn to the computer screen. At that moment, the man bolted from his seat and shoved the sergeant aside, grabbed the stone and barreled towards the door. The officers at the door were tossed aside as the man ran through the door and into the street. The fallen officers quickly got up and chased after the man. The sergeant considered chasing him as well, but knew at his age, he wouldn't make it far. He sighed and groaned as he lowered himself back onto his chair. He glanced at the computer screen once more and saw the result of the search.

Kyle Vasten: Missing, presumed dead.

DOB: 01/23/1963

Last seen: 05/12/1988 in the vicinity of the Great Desert. Believed to have traveled into the desert on an expedition with four others. All missing and presumed dead.

The sergeant stared closely at the picture accompanying the missing persons picture. It was him. It was him without the sand and dirt. The man he saw, the man who fled, was exactly as he was in his picture. No an extra wrinkle or sign of age at all.
